# The pump procedure

1. Open the valve and remove the cap.
2. Push and hold the button.
3. Close the valve before you start the pump.
4. Before you start the pump, close the valve.
5. Close the valve after the test.
6. Turn the knob or push the button.

**NOTE:** Disconnect the power first.

**NOTE:** The capacitor keeps a charge.

**WARNING:** The surface is hot. It can burn your skin.

**CAUTION:** Do not drop the unit. A fall can cause damage to the unit.
